note: E01: brms xbeta (extended-support beta, Kosmidis & Zeileis 2024) on tier_e's zoprop: logit link on mu, phi and kappa (log); B ~ Beta(mu phi, (1 - mu) phi) stretched to (1 + 2 kappa) B - kappa and censored to [0, 1]: P(0) = BetaCDF(kappa / (1 + 2 kappa)), P(1) = 1 - BetaCDF((1 + kappa) / (1 + 2 kappa)), density BetaPDF((y + kappa) / (1 + 2 kappa)) / (1 + 2 kappa) inside; epred is the mean of that censored variable, not mu (the density checked on the frozen points, the mean by quadrature to 1e-9); deterministic (brms's epred passed the two-seed check)
